services.name: Payment Gateway API
services.description: MFS Payment Gateway API v2 for tokenized payment processing, multi-currency support, and idempotent retry handling.

services.name: Token Vault API
services.description: MFS Token Vault API for PCI DSS compliant cardholder data tokenization and HSM key management.

services.name: Settlement API
services.description: MFS Settlement API for batch settlement processing, reconciliation, and settlement file management.

endpoints.name: Create Payment Token
endpoints.description: Tokenize cardholder PAN data. Returns an irreversible token for use in payment processing.

endpoints.name: Get Token Metadata
endpoints.description: Retrieve token metadata (last four digits, brand, creation date). Never returns raw PAN.

endpoints.name: Process Payment
endpoints.description: Process a payment using a previously created token. Supports idempotency keys for safe retries.

endpoints.name: Retry Payment
endpoints.description: Retry a failed payment with idempotency guarantee. Subject to circuit breaker policy.

endpoints.name: Payment Status
endpoints.description: Check payment processing status and details.

endpoints.name: Get Exchange Rates
endpoints.description: Get current FX rates for supported currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF).

endpoints.name: Process Payment with Currency Conversion
endpoints.description: Process a payment with automatic currency conversion at current FX rate.

endpoints.name: Encrypt Data
endpoints.description: Encrypt cardholder data using HSM-managed AES-256-GCM key.

endpoints.name: Decrypt Data
endpoints.description: Decrypt cardholder data using HSM-managed key. All operations are audit-logged.

endpoints.name: Trigger Settlement Batch
endpoints.description: Trigger a settlement batch for pending transactions. Aggregates by merchant, currency, and acquirer.

endpoints.name: Settlement Batch Status
endpoints.description: Get settlement batch status including transaction count, total amount, and reconciliation state.
